name: full vambraces
_design_note: F50-100 heavy arms slot. Full articulated plate, elbow couter and forearm rerebrace. Pairs with plate/full plate body. Vambraces_of_Achilles uses this as template_basis.
lore_template: A pair of full {material_name} vambraces with a hinged cup at the elbow and a fluted plate above it. With gauntlets they sheathe the arm from fingertip to shoulder. The smith's mark is on the inside seam, where the wearer will probably never look.
